steps.title: Tell us what’s moving
steps.text: Pick your rooms and quantities for an instant first estimate.

steps.title: We confirm the details
steps.text: Share access notes and dates by email. We’ll reply with a fixed quote.

steps.title: Put the kettle on
steps.text: Our insured team handles the lift, load and careful delivery.

faqs.question: Is the online price a final quote?
faqs.answer: It is a useful ballpark based on room volume and a local move. We confirm access, distance, floors and special items before sending a fixed quote.

faqs.question: Do you dismantle furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Standard bed frames, tables and wardrobes can be dismantled and rebuilt when agreed in your quote.

faqs.question: Are my belongings insured?
faqs.answer: Yes. Goods in transit and public liability cover are included. We will share the policy details with your written quote.

faqs.question: Can you help with packing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add a note to your email enquiry and we can price full packing, fragile-only packing or reusable crate hire.

faqs.question: How far do you travel?
faqs.answer: We collect across Bristol, Bath and nearby towns, and deliver throughout mainland Great Britain.
